'''Streen Squad''' was a unit of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] that served in [[Thrawn's confederation]]. They were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force deployed to [[Raid on Saarn|face]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]]. They were armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], and [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]].
